changelog: SEO platform (Phase 1): central renderMeta() for unique title/description/canonical/robots/OG/Twitter/hreflang on every page, plus Search Console/Bing verification and GA4/GTM injection
Dynamic sitemap index at /sitemap.xml → pages, restaurants (auto-split at 40k, respects each client's indexing toggle), cities and blog children, cached 6h; dynamic /robots.txt

Programmatic city pages at /digital-menu/{city} (45+ Indian cities seeded incl. all major Gujarat towns) with 500+ words of unique local content, live restaurant listings, FAQ + LocalBusiness/Service/Breadcrumb schema; state pages and /qr-menu-for/{type} cuisine pages

Public menu SEO: keyword-rich auto title/description, full Restaurant + nested Menu + Breadcrumb JSON-LD (real ratings only), per-item alt text, and a client 'Allow Google indexing' toggle (noindex + sitemap exclusion when off)
Admin → SEO Manager: GSC/Bing/GA4/GTM settings, city-page manager with CSV bulk import, keyword tracker, redirect manager and a 404 log; IndexNow + Google/Bing sitemap ping on new menu publish

Custom 404 page with logging + redirect handling; security headers (HSTS, Permissions-Policy), GZIP and 1-year asset caching; homepage Organization + WebSite(SearchAction) + SoftwareApplication schema (removed the previous placeholder rating)
Website Analytics (Admin → Website Analytics): daily & all-time visitors across the whole platform, a 30-day trend chart and a 'top pages' breakdown of what people open most

Visitor counting is deduped per device per day (refreshes and repeat opens are never double-counted); bots, super-admin visits, AJAX and internal panel/API/asset requests are excluded; restaurant menus are grouped together

SEO built in: the landing page now has full meta/Open Graph/Twitter tags and SoftwareApplication structured data, each restaurant menu has local-SEO tags, plus a dynamic /sitemap.xml (every live menu) and robots.txt — so your site can rank when people search for a digital/QR menu

Refer & Earn: every restaurant gets a shareable referral link; when someone they invite buys any plan, the referrer automatically gets bonus days (default 30, configurable). New 'Refer & Earn' page with link, WhatsApp/Facebook share and referral history
Admin Marketing & Growth page: a ready-to-run Ads Kit (Google keywords + ad copy, Facebook/Instagram ad text in English + Gujarati, WhatsApp broadcast, hashtags) with one-click copy
Ad-budget tracker: shows total paid revenue and the share you want to reinvest in ads (default 50%, editable) for all-time and this month — so you know exactly how much to spend after each sale
Fixed WhatsApp buttons on the public menu (and support/renew links): numbers are now normalised with the 91 country code in every format, so the chat actually opens
OTP login now shows a clear on-screen confirmation ('OTP sent to your WhatsApp. Valid for 5 minutes.') — earlier nothing appeared
OTP resend has a 30-second countdown on the button plus a server-side 30s cooldown (and the existing max-3-in-5-minutes cap) to avoid repeat sends and control cost
OTP login accepts the mobile in any format (+91 / 0 / spaces) and matches it reliably

Animated hero on the landing page: an illustrated person presents a live phone that browses the menu, taps 'Add to Order' and shows an 'Order placed!' confirmation on a loop — with floating food, a cart badge and a gentle float
Signup always grants the free, unlimited 7-day trial (never a paid plan's long validity) and enables direct ordering so new users get the full experience

WhatsApp numbers are now accepted in any format — spaces, +91, 0091, leading 0, dashes, brackets — and normalised to a clean Indian number so the message always sends; the signup mobile field accepts these too
WhatsApp master switch now truly stops everything: turning it off in Admin → WhatsApp sends nothing (orders, welcome, reminders) and never queues 'pending' messages

New-order voice alert: the Orders board and Kitchen screen now play a chime and speak a short Hindi announcement ('आपके यहाँ एक नया ऑर्डर आया है, प्लीज़ देख लीजिए') when a new order arrives and sound is on
Colorful, print-ready invoice: every subscription payment gets a polished invoice (gradient header, PAID stamp, GST breakdown) — download it from client Plans → Billing history or Admin → Invoices
Plans & Billing for logged-in clients: a new page shows the current plan (with expiry / days left) and every available plan, clearly marking the one you're on

Buy or renew a plan from inside the panel with payment: online via Razorpay (auto-activates instantly) when configured, otherwise offline via UPI/GPay with a scan-to-pay QR and a 'send screenshot to WhatsApp' flow
Super Admin → Plan Requests: approve offline payments to activate/renew a restaurant's plan (marks the invoice paid and WhatsApps the client), or reject; a badge shows pending requests
Settings → Payments: set the UPI number (default 9978123146), UPI ID and payee name for offline subscription payments; Razorpay stays optional for online
Renewing the same plan early now stacks the new validity on remaining days instead of losing time
Menu scan counting made robust: counts every real menu open even before the analytics migration has run (the daily-views table is auto-created on first open)
Device-based dedup: one device counts once per day (resets next morning at 4am) so refreshes and repeat opens don't inflate the number; owner/super-admin previews are never counted

Discounts & Coupons: per-restaurant promo codes (flat/percent, min order, max-discount cap, usage limit, expiry) with a customer 'Have a coupon?' box in the cart and server-side re-validation on order placement
Menu scan analytics: per-restaurant daily opens on client & super-admin dashboards
POS-style order flow: owner Orders board simplified to New/Active, Completed and Cancelled
Payment collection: 'Complete & Collect Payment' with Cash / UPI / Card / Bank / Online / Due, cash change calculation
Standalone 'Mark Paid' on any unpaid order; payment mode + paid/unpaid shown in order detail and printed bill
Reports: payment breakdown by mode (cash vs bank vs UPI) plus paid vs unpaid dues for the date range
Widened orders.payment_mode to VARCHAR(20) (migration 1.0.4) with a safe auto-migrator on admin load
Fixed one-click update download (GitHub zipball HTTP 415): download by commit SHA with the correct Accept header
Updates: switched to simple branch/commit-based updates — set repo + branch + token once, then Check & Update straight from GitHub (no Releases needed)
Update Settings simplified to 3 fields (owner/repo, branch, token); branch is now free text
Version badge and history now track the git commit (like gh:abc1234)
One-click vegetarian Demo Menu (53 items, English + Gujarati, bundled photos)
Gemini: model auto-fallback (handles retired models), 429 retry, live Test tool in Settings
Fixed QR/menu images on cPanel; installer SQL import and JSON-safe errors
